---
title: "nmaplot test"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r packages}
library(netmeta)
library(nmaplots)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 9, fig.height = 9.5, dpi = 150)
```

```{r data}
data(Franchini2012)
```

```{r network}
p1 <- pairwise(list(Treatment1, Treatment2, Treatment3),
               n = list(n1, n2, n3),
               mean = list(y1, y2, y3),
               sd = list(sd1, sd2, sd3),
               data = Franchini2012, studlab = Study)

net1 <- netmeta(p1, sm = "MD", reference.group = "plac")

nmaplot(net1, outcome = "Change in UPDRS motor score")
```

```{r ring}
# subgroup ring, e.g. study design (RCT vs PSM): one row per treatment x group (counts or %)
design <- data.frame(treatment = rep(net1$trts, each = 2),
                     group = rep(c("RCT", "PSM"), length(net1$trts)),
                     value = c(4, 2,  3, 2,  2, 1,  3, 0,  2, 2))

nmaplot(net1, ring = design, ring_name = "Study design", outcome = "Change in UPDRS motor score")
```

```{r layouts}
nmaplot(net1, ring = design, ring_name = "Study design", outcome = "Change in UPDRS motor score", layout = "circle")
nmaplot(net1, ring = design, ring_name = "Study design", outcome = "Change in UPDRS motor score", layout = "star")
```

```{r save}
nmaplot(net1, ring = design, ring_name = "Study design", outcome = "Change in UPDRS motor score",
        file = c("franchini_net_graph.png", "franchini_net_graph.pdf", "franchini_net_graph.tiff"),
        width = 9, height = 9.5, dpi = 300)
```
